_comment: A FIXTURE standing in for the semantic classifier on the zero-model path. It is not a model, it says nothing about how accurate a model would be, and no live model has been run against this caseload. It is a committed map from clinical terms to extremity groups, replayed through Strands' real structured-output path and Recheck's real validation, so a sweep is byte-reproducible offline. It lists only clinical names OUTSIDE the rating schedule's vocabulary - schedule names are resolved by the deterministic lexicon and never reach it. A term it does not list is returned at confidence 0.0 and refused by the confidence floor; the caseload deliberately contains one such term ('Lisfranc injury') so that path is exercised. It has no field for a side; sides are read from the letters by deterministic code. A live classifier replaces it via --model.
